edits.old: SELECT ow.organization_id,'workday' source_relation,count(DISTINCT r.organization_role_id) unique_organization_roles,count(DISTINCT ow.organization_worker_code) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code ILIKE '%Manager%') management_role_employees,count(DISTINCT ow.organization_worker_code) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code ILIKE '%Director%') director_role_employees,count(DISTINCT ow.organization_worker_code) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code ILIKE '%Lead%') lead_role_employees FROM staging.stg_workday__organization_role_worker ow LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role r ON ow.organization_id=r.organization_id AND ow.role_id=r.organization_role_id GROUP BY ow.organization_id
edits.new: SELECT wpo.organization_id,wpo.source_relation,count(DISTINCT ow.role_id) unique_organization_roles,count(DISTINCT wpo.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code LIKE '%Manager%') management_role_employees,count(DISTINCT wpo.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code LIKE '%Director%') director_role_employees,count(DISTINCT wpo.worker_id) FILTER(WHERE r.organization_role_code LIKE '%Lead%') lead_role_employees FROM staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization wpo LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role_worker ow ON wpo.worker_id=ow.organization_worker_code AND wpo.source_relation=ow.source_relation LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role r ON ow.role_id=r.organization_role_id AND ow.source_relation=r.source_relation AND wpo.organization_id=r.organization_id GROUP BY wpo.organization_id,wpo.source_relation

edits.old:
SELECT worker_id,organization_id,source_relation,position_id,effective_start,effective_end,
 date_diff('day',effective_start,coalesce(effective_end,DATE '2025-10-13')) duration,
 CASE WHEN effective_end IS NULL THEN 'Active Assignment' ELSE 'Former Assignment' END status
 FROM staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization
edits.new:
SELECT wpo.worker_id,wpo.organization_id,wpo.source_relation,wpo.position_id,wpo.effective_start,wpo.effective_end,
 date_diff('day',effective_start,coalesce(effective_end,DATE '2025-10-13')) duration,
 CASE WHEN effective_end IS NULL THEN 'Active Assignment' ELSE 'Former Assignment' END status
 FROM staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization wpo LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role_worker ow ON wpo.worker_id=ow.organization_worker_code AND wpo.source_relation=ow.source_relation LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization_role r ON ow.role_id=r.organization_role_id AND ow.source_relation=r.source_relation AND wpo.organization_id=r.organization_id
